Addendum, markers, registry and LAW_MAP reworded, a RETRACTIONS row. (2) The seat's fixed-point companions registered at FK14 as the first candidate answer to what adds an end: the maximal abelian cover to which the cusp lifts is the monodromy's mapping torus with every fixed point punctured, |2 - tr phi| ends; verified on main: o10_150729 is S^3 - L10n113 (m003's five-ended companion) and +LLLR (trace 5) has a three-ended companion, the link complement L8a15, chiral, |Sym| = 12 -- the first three-ended object of that kind on the record; whether a companion is a generated state is FK14 itself, not ruled. 0 of 19.
